scope: strict merged source caller audit; macro guards reviewed, not runtime trace
firmware_init_chain: RTMP initialization in common/rtmp_init_inf.c calls MCUSysInit
MT PCI MCU hook assigns FwInit = AndesMTPciFwInit
legacy_radio_on: only direct source call is under RTMP_MAC || RLT_MAC; HIF_MT dispatch returns via MTPciMlmeRadioOn earlier; MT7603 AsicRadioOn assignment is commented out
required: trace RTMP init admission/lifetime before fencing MCUSysInit; a check-only retiring read cannot join an already running initializer

ownership_audit.open_entry: rt28xx_open reserves WR_PEER_OPEN_BEGIN before IRQ request and rt28xx_init
ownership_audit.init_check: rt28xx_init checks exact CONFIG ticket before MCU initialization
ownership_audit.lock: peer open dispatch uses MacTabLock; radio retirement uses transition lock
ownership_audit.gap: CONFIG ticket check is admission only, not join of the full MCU initializer; peer ticket and transition retirement must be coordinated
ownership_audit.next: trace top-level virtual OPEN ticket and RTNL serialization before introducing another owner

top_level_audit.main_open: MainVirtualIF_open reserves radio ticket under transition lock before VIRTUAL_IF_UP_CLAIM; MCU init is inside this call
top_level_audit.remove: rt_pci_remove marks retiring and joins recovery work before RtmpPhyNetDevExit
top_level_audit.rtnl: RtmpPhyNetDevExit takes RTNL around final main unregister; rt_pci_remove itself does not take RTNL before retirement/work drain
top_level_audit.implication: normal ndo_open RTNL serialization is eventually joined at unregister, but not proof of initializer quiescence during earlier removal phases
top_level_audit.required: establish exact OPEN ticket completion before hardware fence while avoiding RTNL/work join inversion
